method: Read-only inspection of report_view.py, report.js and report.css plus web.run reads of official primary references. No UI measurements or assistive-technology tests were performed by this research task.
scope: Local static report with progressive JavaScript enhancement. No runtime dependency, component framework, copied source code, brand asset, template or external service integration proposed.

reuse.license_notes: Licenses identify consulted references only. Carbon repository license is not asserted to cover every asset on the website. A later actual reuse would require its own attribution and license check.

sources.mechanism: Map checks to Info and Relationships, Use of Color, Contrast, Reflow, Non-text Contrast, Text Spacing, Focus Visible, Focus Not Obscured and Target Size.

sources.kind: Official informative explanation of SC 2.5.8 AA
sources.mechanism: Measure pointer targets at 24 by 24 CSS px or document an applicable spacing/equivalent/inline/user-agent/essential exception. Do not label 44 px a universal AA minimum.

sources.kind: Official informative explanation of SC 1.4.3 AA
sources.mechanism: Compute foreground/background contrast for actual states: 4.5:1 normal text, 3:1 qualifying large text, with criterion exceptions.

sources.kind: Official informative explanation of SC 1.4.11 AA
sources.mechanism: Measure 3:1 for visual cues required to identify active controls/states and meaningful graphics, with criterion exceptions; not every decorative divider.

sources.kind: Official informative explanation of SC 2.4.11 AA
sources.mechanism: Focused control must not be entirely hidden by author-created content. Aim to show the entire control, while distinguishing that stronger goal from the AA criterion.

sources.kind: Official informative explanation of SC 1.4.10 AA
sources.mechanism: Check 320 CSS px vertical layout and equivalent 400% zoom. Data tables may require two dimensions; the exception does not justify whole-page overflow or unreadable individual cell text.

sources.kind: Official informative explanation of SC 1.4.12 AA
sources.mechanism: Check user overrides: line-height 1.5, paragraph spacing 2em, letter spacing .12em, word spacing .16em without information/function loss. These are override test values, not mandatory defaults.
Prefer native a[href] for navigation. A role alone does not supply browser link behavior.
True tabs require tablist/tab/tabpanel relationships, selected state and widget keyboard behavior. Visual resemblance does not require converting section navigation into tabs.
Use caption for table identity and th scope=row/col when both dimensions identify values. For genuinely complex headers, use explicit associations described by the wider tutorial.

sources.version_note: Current main branch read on consultation date; no immutable revision claimed.
sources.kind: Official Vercel Labs design review guidance; not a WCAG standard
sources.mechanism: Semantic native controls, visible focus, heading anchors, URL state, tabular numerals and robust long/empty content. Apply to existing vanilla HTML rather than importing React-specific assumptions.
Analyze after opening the relevant view/disclosure. Automated scans detect a subset of accessibility issues; combine them with keyboard, zoom, spacing and assistive-technology assessment.

sources.mechanism: Use data tables for comparisons, captions/header relationships for context, and right-align numeric comparisons. Retain project CSS/fonts and exact financial formatting.

sources.mechanism: Use native disclosure for secondary supporting detail, not information most readers need to interpret the decision. Write a short descriptive summary.
Use dl/dt/dd for publication/baseline/scope metadata; preserve tables for row/column comparison and lists for simple items.

Adapt static persistent contextual callouts for historical warnings; reserve transient feedback for actions such as copying. Severity meaning and placement are relevant, IBM styling and timing conventions are not imported.

recommendations.observation: HTML has nav with a[href] hash links and all sections visible initially. JavaScript switches panel.hidden and aria-current; links are not ARIA tabs.
recommendations.action: Keep meaningful section URLs, browser history/back behavior, skip link and no-JS access. Do not add tablist/tab/aria-selected without adopting the complete tabs interaction contract.

recommendations.observation: _table gives an aria-label to the scrolling region, but the table itself has no caption/name. All body cells are td, even metric labels.
recommendations.action: Name the table with caption or another explicit table naming relation. Add th scope=row only where the field identifies the row, especially profile metrics. Preserve scope=col. Avoid declaring every first cell a header indiscriminately.

recommendations.observation: _profile_totals preformats exact money/count values then passes them as text, losing _table's numeric class.
recommendations.action: Right-align and use tabular numerals for previous/current numeric strings while retaining their exact server-generated formatting. Do not recalculate Decimal totals or ratios through JavaScript floating-point conversion.

recommendations.status: Design adaptation, not a claimed WCAG failure
recommendations.action: Keep warning result/reason and baseline, dates, stores, coverage and comparison scope visible near profile data. Keep secondary calculation/version explanations in native details. Historical WARNING is not a new live event or a blocked publication: no auto-dismiss or initial role=alert. Copy success may use the existing polite status region.

Represent a measured zero, missing movement/coverage, unknown value, no publication, no baseline, empty scope and insufficient sample with distinct text. Keep exact monetary/count values available beside charts; color alone must not convey these states. Do not coerce missing values to zero or manufacture a zero ticket/ratio when its denominator is absent or zero.
recommendations.inference_note: WCAG supports perceivable text/state semantics; the financial distinction itself comes from this project's data contract, not from an invented WCAG rule.

recommendations.status: Requires browser verification; no geometric defect claimed
recommendations.action: Measure copy controls, compact matrix links and navigation at real CSS sizes. Check visible focus and focused items against overlays/scroll containers; test all actual text/background and meaningful state color pairs. Existing 44/48 px min-heights do not prove every target passes.

Test 320 CSS px, 400% zoom and all text-spacing overrides. Limit necessary horizontal scrolling to data-table containers, allow long labels/IDs to wrap, and ensure no clipping of warnings, exact numbers or focus outlines.

verification_recommendations: Run existing development-only accessibility tooling against each visible navigation view and after opening relevant details; an initial-state-only scan misses hidden content.
Record automatic violations and items requiring manual review separately. Zero automated violations is not evidence of complete WCAG conformance.
Exercise Tab/Shift+Tab/Enter, hash deep links, browser back, skip link, disclosure, copy feedback, scroll regions and any implemented matrix keyboard interaction.
Open the report with JavaScript disabled and check every decision and equivalent data table remains available, including meaningful matrix destinations or equivalent text paths.
Check populated, truly zero, missing/unknown, unpublished, no-baseline, empty and insufficient-sample examples; compare money, ratios and identities to source JSON without rounding or mutation.

Use 320 CSS px plus a wider baseline with 400% browser zoom, text-spacing overrides, reduced-motion preference and print. Measure actual target boxes and contrast rather than assuming CSS tokens pass.
Manual assistive-technology assessment should confirm table navigation announces the table context and relevant row/column headers. No such assessment was performed by this research task.
adaptations_not_imported: No GOV.UK or IBM/Carbon brand, template, typeface, icon set, framework component or runtime package.
No new React keyboard handlers for already-native HTML controls; no nuqs/router dependency for existing hash links.
No blanket Intl.NumberFormat replacement that converts exact Decimal strings to binary floats.
No automatic virtualization, text clamping of critical financial/context data or transient toast replacement for historical report warnings.
External design guidance is advisory and adapted to this report; WCAG criterion levels and exceptions remain distinct from stronger ergonomic preferences.
